description: Use as a SELLER to submit the signed permit from bull_deposit_plan. Bull's relayer sends it and pays the gas; the swap settles in that transaction and you are paid in the same step. Returns the transaction hash. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

fundSig.description: Signature over the `fund` typed data from bull_deposit_plan (the full 65-byte signature).

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

name: bull_deposit
